posts.title: Why Bloomberg gift links don’t work in Safari on macOS Sequoia
posts.description: Mark Gurman of Bloomberg sometimes posts gift links on social media, for example Mastodon , for his Power On newsletter . However, the gift link for today’s newsletter showed only a paywall in Safari, my default web browser. In Chrome and Firefox, on the other hand, the gift link showed the entire newsletter. posts.title: webloc files trigger a Gatekeeper alert in the latest macOS security updates
posts.description: A webloc file is essentially a website bookmark. You can create a webloc file by dragging a URL from the Safari address bar and dropping into Finder.
